description: First-start policy for local user identity, Cap agent identity, and shared-knowledge user namespace. Private identity content stays outside the RedCap repository.
private_identity_rule: Never commit ~/.cap/identity.md or copied private identity text into the RedCap repository; installer writes only ignored local state.
first_start_rule: revive/install must verify the identity anchor, create the ignored local state file, and ensure the current user's shared-knowledge namespace exists in the template and preferred external worktree when available.
